t: This is Baynard House, a brutalist office block on Queen Victoria Street in Blackfriars, occupied by BT Group. It stands on the site of the second Baynard's Castle, and most of the land beneath it is a scheduled monument. From 1982 to 1997 it housed the BT Museum. The architect was William Holford, Baron Holford, who was a British architect and town planner. It's a good place to see how a heavy modern building sits over a much older medieval site.
